title: Domain Expert
summary: Subject-matter authority whose knowledge of the business domain informs definitions and models.
body_markdown:
# Domain Expert

## Purpose

Provide authoritative input on meaning and business rules.

## Responsibilities

- Explain business meaning, exceptions and edge cases.
- Review definitions and models for correctness.

## Decision Rights

None formally; consulted at the semantic and information levels.

## Inputs

Draft definitions and models.

## Outputs

Review comments; examples; edge cases.

## Required Competencies

Deep domain knowledge.

## Escalation Paths

Disagreements on meaning → [[Data Owner]].

## Related Governance Processes

- [[Decision Rights Model]]
- [[Architecture Change Process]]
- [[Governance Lifecycle]]
